$comment: Versioned roster policy for scripts/bench_watch.py. Read-only for the watcher; the owner edits this by hand. Governs which OpenRouter releases are roster-eligible for a paid scan proposal. Evaluation is event-driven per ~/wiki/atlas/givecare-bench.md: a scan runs only on a roster-eligible release or a standard-version change, never on a schedule. See AUTOMATION.md § Watch.

top_n_capability.$comment: Owner-filled: name a capability index (e.g. an Arena or Artificial Analysis leaderboard) and how many of its top slots count as roster-eligible. Left empty on purpose — bench_watch.py treats this rule as inactive (contributes no candidates) until both fields are set, and never guesses an index.
